headline: Brazil Central Bank and CMN Enhance Measures to Mitigate Household and Corporate Debt Risks
summary: The Central Bank of Brazil and the National Monetary Council (CMN) are implementing new regulatory measures to address financial risks associated with the indebtedness of families and companies.
why: The Central Bank of Brazil regulates the national financial system and oversees monetary policy, playing a critical role in maintaining systemic stability in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Regulatory changes regarding debt risk management directly impact the stability and credit conditions of the Brazilian economy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory tightening on debt levels can influence credit availability and interest rate transmission, impacting domestic financial conditions.
